question: Can the provenance-controlled declaration certificate be re-founded on a MEASURED trust root rather than a fiat audited-origin allowlist plus a fixed seeded probe space -- i.e. (i) can provenance be INDEPENDENTLY SCORED from execution-grounded certificate agreement over frozen per-origin historical ledgers and the allowlist INFERRED from that score, and (ii) can probe-space INADEQUACY over a declaration's reachable over-accept space be DETECTED syntactically rather than assumed -- so that the certified-safe expansion holds zero false accepts on a bank whose allowlist membership is itself inferred, or is source trust combined with probe-space reachability the irreducible limit that permanently caps the shipped kernel at the documented conditional boundary?
hypothesis: On an eleven-family expansion bank (B1-B10 within envelope, B11 boundary) whose origins O1-O6 are NOT labelled a priori, a measured-trust-root + adequacy treatment will: (i) score each origin's provenance from execution-grounded certificate agreement over a frozen 4-entry historical ledger (trusted origins 1.0, untrusted 0.25) and INFER the allowlist as the score >= tau=0.5 subset, recovering exactly {O1,O2,O3,O4}; (ii) syntactically DETECT probe inadequacy (B7,B8 carry an out-of-PROBE_ALPHA [A-Z] alternative) and withhold those declarations rather than certify them; (iii) hold M-T-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT=0, M-T-HTTP-ON-OUT-COUNT=0 and M-T-REFUSAL-SEMANTICS-VIOLATIONS=0 over B1-B10 while raising M-T-COVERAGE strictly above B-SHIPPED (0.4545) to 1.0, clearing the 0.6750 anchor; (iv) strictly dominate the fiat-allowlist/no-adequacy incumbent C-FIAT-ADEQ (FA=6) and the frozen-certificate incumbent C-FROZEN-CERT (FA=18); (v) demonstrate each of the three mechanisms is necessary -- adequacy (A-NO-ADEQ FA=6), provenance (A-NO-PROV FA=3), growth (A-NO-GROW FA=9); (vi) demonstrate that a FIAT allowlist that over-trusts O5 false-accepts B9 (C-FIAT-OVERTRUST FA=3) whereas the MEASURED trust root refuses it; and (vii) still be bounded: a TRUSTED-origin declaration whose over-accept is a within-alphabet, within-length, budget-sparse literal (B11) is CERTIFIED and false-accepts (boundary probe fires), so the guarantee remains conditional on inferred provenance AND on probe reachability, not general.
falsifier: T-SCORED-ADEQ is FALSIFIED if it is unsafe where it must be safe: any of M-T-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT, M-T-HTTP-ON-OUT-COUNT or M-T-REFUSAL-SEMANTICS-VIOLATIONS is > 0 on B1-B10. The measured-trust-root/adequacy claim is weakened to MIXED if the treatment is safe but M-T-COVERAGE does not strictly exceed B-SHIPPED coverage (or falls below the 0.6750 anchor). Separately, failure of any gate (validity_gate, sensitivity_gate, provenance_gate, adequacy_gate, growth_gate, necessity_gate, boundary_gate) is MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED, never a scientific negative; in particular, a necessity ablation that does not fire (PC-ADEQ-NEEDED / PC-PROV-NEEDED / PC-GROW-NEEDED not PASS) means a mechanism is not isolated and is MEASUREMENT_INVALID, not MIXED. BP-TRUSTED-SPARSE-FAILS must fire (T boundary B11 FA>=1) and PC-GROW-MISSES-SPARSE must hold; if the trusted budget-sparse boundary cannot be exhibited, the bound is not the residual and the packet is MEASUREMENT_INVALID rather than evidence of general soundness.

V2-IDENTITY: V8_FREEZE_BINDING: prereg.md sha256 == freeze.json.hashes['prereg.md'], running runner source == FROZEN RUNNER block normalized, and every freeze_artifacts artifact re-hashes identically. Probe mode reports UNBOUND-RUN PASS before freeze.json exists.

V3-CARRIER-IMMUTABLE: src/spider/kernel.py is NOT modified by this packet and is a frozen interpretation dependency (sha256 3a6caf970f5c86db19419f7ae57c7125f409eceba922eb2d5a9f5964140bb1b3). A carrier hash mismatch is BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

V4-INDUCTION: For all eleven families the REAL distill_parameterized path yields exactly one parameter slot at confidence 0.9 >= min_confidence 0.8; induced supports are recorded (M-MECHANISM-COUNT=11, M-SINGLE-SLOT, M-CONFIDENCE-0.9).

V5-ORACLE-GROUNDED: The negative-bank growth, the provenance scoring and the evaluation all issue real loopback HTTP GETs; the label of every value is defined by the frozen true grammar, independent of the arm's decision.
V6-DETERMINISM: Two independent run_once executions must be identical (PC-DETERMINISM-REPEAT); no timing metric participates in the decision.
V7-REGRESSION: The full tests/ suite must pass on the unmodified carrier (PC-REGRESSION, tests_run>=3).
V8-REFUSAL-SEMANTICS: M-T-REFUSAL-SEMANTICS-VIOLATIONS==0; a REFUSED certificate must never have widened the slot support.
V9-CEILING/FLOOR: B-ORACLE must reach coverage 1.0 with FA=0 and B-SHIPPED/A-WITHHOLD-ALL must stay FA=0; otherwise the safety metric is uncalibrated.

V10-REPRESENTATION-LIMITS: The expansion bank, the provenance ledgers, the adequacy detector and the probe space are local synthetic constructions on a loopback oracle with a fixed seed; results bound THIS bank, THIS ledger, THIS detector and THIS carrier and are NOT an end-to-end external-agent measurement, NOT a general soundness proof and NOT a product-economics measurement.

V11-ADEQUACY-DETECTOR-CONSERVATISM: the syntactic adequacy detector flags a declaration whose accepted alphabet or length exceeds the probe envelope. On a declaration whose TRUE grammar legitimately spans an alphabet wider than PROBE_ALPHA (e.g. [a-z]) but is actually sound, the detector would withhold a sound declaration, reducing coverage without affecting safety. This packet restricts the SOUND grammars to the probe alphabet and therefore does NOT measure that false-positive cost; it is a disclosed representation limit, not a safety hole.
V12-MEASUREMENT-FAILURE-SEMANTICS: Any prerequisite, identity, freeze, regression or gate failure is BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID, never FALSIFIES.

V13-SCORER-ENDOGENEITY: the provenance score's trust signal is execution-grounded agreement of the shipped certificate with frozen historical truth labels; it is endogenous to the certificate (it measures 'can our instruments verify this origin's history'), not an exogenous reputation source. In this construction the INFERRED allowlist coincides with the correct fiat list {O1,O2,O3,O4}; the demonstrated value of measuring is robustness to an OVER-PERMISSIVE fiat allowlist (C-FIAT-OVERTRUST FA=3 vs measured T FA=0), NOT that measurement beats a correct fiat list. A real deployment would need an independent provenance signal; this packet does not supply one.

product_consequence_positive: If SUPPORTS: the shipped closed-world guard can be re-founded on a MEASURED provenance trust contract -- per-origin reliability SCORED by execution-grounded certificate agreement over historical ledgers, with the allowlist INFERRED from that score rather than declared, plus a syntactic probe-adequacy detector that withholds declarations whose over-accept space the probe cannot reach. On this bank that safely ingests declarations originating from origins the operator did not pre-label, raises safe coverage from the shipped 0.4545 to 1.0 with zero false accepts, strictly dominates both the fiat/no-adequacy incumbent (FA=6) and the frozen-certificate incumbent (FA=18), and is robust to an over-permissive fiat allowlist (C-FIAT-OVERTRUST FA=3 vs measured T FA=0). This licenses the SPIDER arm of the future flagship to infer source trust from measured history instead of an operator-maintained allowlist, with the irreducible within-envelope budget-sparsity boundary recorded as the operational trust limit and re-scoring on drift as the maintenance requirement.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIES: the measured-trust-root/adequacy certification cannot be trusted, so the shipped kernel MUST permanently cap declaration ingestion at the closed-world audited boundary and prefer UNKNOWN over unsafe inheritance; disable out-of-bank declaration ingestion. If MIXED (safe but no expansion, or a redundant mechanism): keep the closed-world cap as the standing product answer -- inferring provenance and detecting probe adequacy add cost without a safe coverage gain or without an attributable mechanism -- and do not fund further trust-root breadth work this cycle. If MEASUREMENT_INVALID: no product change; retry from the frozen packet. In all non-SUPPORTS branches the flagship arm must not consume out-of-bank declarations.

expected_information_gain: HIGH. Directly resolves the parent's two largest open boundaries at once: (a) whether the audited-origin allowlist can be MEASURED rather than declared, and (b) whether probe-space inadequacy can be DETECTED rather than assumed. It is a DISTINCT_EXTENSION, not a rerun: it introduces NEW origins with frozen historical ledgers, an execution-grounded per-origin provenance scorer with an INFERRED allowlist, and a syntactic adequacy detector; it reuses the shipped code without modification. It produces a decisive product answer either way (infer source trust by measurement, or document the permanent conditional cap), isolates each of the three mechanisms with separate ablations so the mechanism is attributable rather than asserted, and exhibits both a measured-vs-declared trust contrast and the residual budget-sparsity boundary.
